prompt:
Create an exactly 10-second vertical 9:16 dark-fantasy anime climax edited as six distinct shots joined by clean hard cuts, like the final minute of a top-studio anime episode. @Image1 is the reference for shot 1 (0–1.2s), @Image2 for shot 2 (1.2–2.7s), @Image3 for shot 3 (2.7–4.1s), @Image4 for shot 4 (4.1–6.3s), @Image5 for shot 5 (6.3–7.9s) and @Image6 for shot 6 (7.9–10s). The references guide newly animated shots; never show them as stills or as a panel layout.

A storm-lashed gothic throne room at night: crimson carpet, raised dais, massive dark-and-gold throne, stone pillars, iron candelabras, rain streaming down abstract stained glass. The hero: about 19, messy dark-brown hair, warm brown eyes, thin scar on his left cheekbone, long black coat with crimson lining and gold trim, black trousers, dark boots, one sword in one black scabbard at his left hip. King Aurelius: about 25, long straight pale-blond hair, cool blue eyes, white-and-gold filigree plate armour, white fur-trimmed cloak.

Shot 1, 0–1.2s, extreme close-up, static: the hero's single hand snatches the one ornate gold crown, tall spires and deep-red gems, off the king's head and pulls it out of frame. Clean cut.
Shot 2, 1.2–2.7s, medium shot, slow push in: the hero lowers that same crown onto his own hair with both hands; behind him on the throne the bareheaded king's eyes go wide. Clean cut.
Shot 3, 2.7–4.1s, wide low angle from the carpet, static: the crowned hero at centre, the bareheaded king behind; exactly four visored guards snap their longswords out at the same instant. Clean cut.
Shot 4, 4.1–6.3s, close-up of the bareheaded king, very slow push in: surprise, then stillness, then a slow faint impressed smile; his lips move briefly, silently. Clean cut.
Shot 5, 6.3–7.9s, medium close-up of the crowned hero, static: sword tips point at him from both frame edges; his eyes go wide and he glances left, then right, a comic "oh no" look. Clean cut.
Shot 6, 7.9–10s, close-up, fast push in toward his face: guards charge, blurred, behind him; he draws his sword up into a guard and breaks into a wide reckless grin, crown still on.

There is only ever one crown; after shot 1 the king stays bareheaded and the crown stays on the hero. Guards never show faces; never more than four in focus. Faces, costumes, throne and lighting stay locked across every cut. Two-tone cel shading, crisp linework, night-blue moonlight against hot gold candlelight, crimson accents, painterly backgrounds, shallow depth of field, subtle grain.

No subtitles, watermarks, UI overlays, borders, split screen, on-screen text, captions, logos, letters, numbers, symbols, extra crowns, extra swords, guard faces, 3D CG or glossy plastic look.

Synchronized audio: storm rain on glass throughout under a low, tense orchestral anime score; one bright metallic clink at the snatch; one ringing SHING as the four swords are drawn together; heavy armoured footsteps in the final shot. No voices, narration or dialogue.
